verdict.rationale: First-party docs show per-item control over physical mail: a few taps let users ask the operator to open and scan, forward, or securely shred an item, or schedule a pickup. That covers on-request shredding and per-item disposal choices. Nothing in the pack documents storage windows or a shredding confirmation. Missing for 10: documented storage windows/retention periods, shred confirmation (e.g. certificate or notification), independent or hands-on corroboration.
